neet_che_u01_t07_1.working: C3H8 + 5O2 → 3CO2 + 4H2O. Each mole of propane gives 3 mol CO2, so 2 mol gives 6 mol CO2.

neet_che_u01_t07_2.working: N2 = 28/28 = 1 mol; H2 = 4/2 = 2 mol. 1 mol N2 needs 3 mol H2, so H2 is limiting. NH3 formed = (2/3) × 2 = 4/3 mol; mass = (4/3) × 17 ≈ 22.67 g.

neet_che_u01_t07_3.working: Molarity depends on solution volume, which changes with temperature. Molality, mole fraction and mass percent depend only on masses or moles.

neet_che_u01_t07_4.working: Molarity = n/V(L) (III). Molality = n/W(kg) (I). Mole fraction of A = nA/(nA+nB) (IV). Percentage yield = actual/theoretical × 100 (II).

neet_che_u01_t07_5.working: A: CH4 + 2O2 → CO2 + 2H2O, so 1 volume needs 2 volumes O2; true. B: limiting reagent is set by mole ratio, not mass; false. C: true. D: coefficients give mole or volume ratios, not mass ratios; false. E: molality is mass-based, so independent of temperature; true. Correct: A, C, E.
